name: CM38_the_model_runs_as_one
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (the whole model runs at the same time, improves whenever it is used, finds its weaknesses like an individual unit)
statement: The model runs as one unit: one bounded cycle runs every part of it (the core ledger, every witness, every law's witness test, the learning loop on its own code and across the language cards, verified optimisation, the goals, the arcade's catalogue, the generated documents, the test suite) under the resource governor, keeps the evidence, compares it with the last run and writes the weakness report: regressions, failing and vacuous witnesses, unmet goals and what would move them, and where development falls short. Using the model starts a cycle when one is due.
